name: The Will Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that the will of God is both a divine purpose and a standard for believers to follow and obey. Jesus teaches the importance of aligning with God's will, as seen in the call to pray for His name to be hallowed (Matthew 6:9) and in the authority to forgive sins (Matthew 9:6). Believers are identified as family members of Christ when they do God's will (Mark 3:35), and are urged to be transformed by renewing their minds to discern His good, acceptable, and perfect will (Romans 12:2). Furthermore, God's will is sovereignly executed according to His counsel and purpose, as believers are predestined in Christ (Ephesians 1:11).
